scope: Evaluator-only authored ordinary reference baseline from the stipulated synthetic case. This incomplete archive is neither empirical evidence nor a recommended correct solution. Absence from it supports no global novelty inference.

families.plain_description: Prepare a checked parts kit for each order.
families.actor_operation_target: Worker gathers required parts into an order-specific tray or bundle and checks them against a parts list.
families.causal_path_or_observable: A complete kit reduces bin switching and missing or incorrect partitions during packing.
families.conditions: Preserve ordered colors and compartment counts within material and startup allowances.
families.assumptions: Each layout has a dependable parts list and inexpensive temporary containers suffice.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Mark matching parts and supply the ordered layout diagram.
families.actor_operation_target: Workshop adds simple removable or printed identifiers to partitions and their positions on the customer diagram.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Explicit correspondence helps customers place short partitions without assistance.
families.conditions: The assembled footprint and rearrangeable construction remain compliant.
families.assumptions: Markings are legible and can be produced within the recurring cost limit.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Group production by layout and color.
families.actor_operation_target: Workers sequence compatible orders together while retaining individual order slips for final checks.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Fewer configuration changes reduce repeated selection and setup work.
families.conditions: Every accepted order ships by its existing date and retains its selected configuration.
families.assumptions: Grouping is practical within the small batch and does not create identification errors.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Pack checked component sets for customer assembly.
families.actor_operation_target: Workshop omits full preassembly and packs each complete kit with clear assembly instructions.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Removing workshop insertion work may shorten production and simplify packaging.
families.conditions: Unaided customer setup, dismantling, capacity, and delivery requirements still need to be met.
families.assumptions: Customers can assemble reliably with the supplied instructions and transport does not damage loose parts.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: Which production stage causes the long orders?
families.actor_operation_target: Observer separately times selection, insertion, checking, and packing across repeated and mixed layouts.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Stage timings identify where configuration changes or rework create the largest delay.
families.conditions: Observation fits normal bench work and the fixed delivery window.
families.assumptions: The observed mix covers common and uncommon order variants.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs

families.plain_description: What explains failed insertion and partition placement?
families.actor_operation_target: Workers inspect sample slot geometry and customer participants attempt the ordered layout while explaining ambiguities.
families.causal_path_or_observable: Fit measurements and observed mistakes distinguish physical interference from identification problems.
families.conditions: Use available sample board and preserve the requested compartment functions.
families.assumptions: A small sample can expose common failure modes without proving their prevalence.
families.provenance: archive-author ordinary baseline before treatment outputs
